query:
SELECT CEIL(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MIN(rp.release_at) - NOW())))::BIGINT
        FROM rb_puzzle p
        JOIN rb_release_phase rp ON rp.id = p.release_phase_id
        JOIN rb_team_puzzle tp ON tp.puzzle_id = p.id
            AND tp.team_id = $1
            AND tp.state >= 0
        WHERE p.round_id = $2
            AND rp.release_at > NOW();
